queries: WITH g AS (SELECT c.gender AS gender, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), s AS (SELECT gender, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT gender, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT gender, cnt AS invoice_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

assumptions.assumption: Inner joins Invoices->Orders->Customers drop invoices lacking an order or customer; each invoice row counted once.
Customers with NULL gender form their own group (NULL) and count as a gender in the average; the request does not say to exclude them.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude customers with NULL gender from the groups and from the average.
